$comment: Example resources. Not shown in the registries; used to preview entry.html (?src=example) and to test scripts/validate.py. Each card field explains what belongs in it.

datasets.title: Example dataset entry
datasets.summary: A placeholder that shows how a released dataset is laid out, with every field of the dataset card filled.
datasets.access: Open download. Source imagery is not redistributed; derived values only.
datasets.citation: Author One and Author Two (2026). Example dataset entry, version 1.0.0. UrbanProbe. https://urbanprobe.com/entry.html?registry=datasets&id=example-dataset

card.geography_time: Give the extent, the spatial unit or raster resolution, the coordinate reference system, the period covered, and how often the data is updated.
card.variables_schema: List every field with its type, unit, allowed values, and how missing values are coded.
card.provenance: Name each original provider, how the data was collected or obtained, the sampling, and the rights attached to each source.
card.processing: Describe cleaning, joining, aggregation, and derivation in order, and link the script that performs each step.
card.validation: Report completeness and consistency checks, comparison with reference data, and known error rates.
card.limitations: Describe coverage gaps, biases, mismatches in time between sources, and uses the dataset does not support.

indicators.title: Example indicator entry
indicators.summary: A placeholder that shows how a released indicator is laid out, from definition to sensitivity analysis.
indicators.citation: Author One (2026). Example indicator entry, version 2.0.0. UrbanProbe.

card.definition: Say what the indicator is meant to measure, the concept behind it, and why this way of measuring it was chosen.
card.provenance: List the datasets it is computed from, with their versions, and every parameter or threshold.
card.processing: Give the formula or algorithm step by step, and link the code that implements it.
card.spatial_scale: Name the unit the values are reported at, and explain how the indicator behaves when aggregated or split.
card.geography_time: Name the places and periods for which values are released.
card.validation: Report agreement with ground truth, surveys, or established measures.
card.sensitivity: Show how values change with parameter choices and input errors, and how uncertainty is reported.
card.limitations: Name contexts where the indicator is not valid, and interpretations it does not support.

indicators.title: Example indicator entry (first version)
indicators.summary: A placeholder for a deprecated resource, kept for the record and pointing to its replacement.

methods.title: Example method entry
methods.summary: A placeholder that shows how a released method is laid out, including its worked example and maintenance status.
methods.citation: Author One and Author Two (2026). Example method entry, version 0.4.1. UrbanProbe.

card.problem_users: State the urban question the method answers and who is expected to run it.
card.inputs_outputs: List required inputs with formats and sources, and the outputs with their schema.
card.provenance: Name the data the method was developed and tested on, and the rights attached to it.
card.processing: List the pipeline steps in order, with software dependencies and their versions.
card.installation_runtime: Explain how to set up the environment, and give the expected run time and hardware.
card.example: Provide a worked example with small test data that reproduces a published result.
card.geography_time: Name the places and periods where the method has been applied and checked.
card.validation: Explain how outputs were checked, including comparison with alternative methods.
card.maintenance: Say whether the method is maintained, by whom, and link the open issues.
card.limitations: Describe where the method breaks down and what it should not be used for.
